scope: Independent review of the bounded service-only provider failure diagnostic projection. Full integrated CI and publication remain root-owned gates.

materialChecks.evidence: Exact one-file 14+/6- diff; adapter, read guard, cooldown, store, MCP, policy/types and locks unchanged.
providerErrorCode uses constructor-bound WeakMap; code must be in existing BANK_JOB_ERROR_CODES. Unknown and spoofed values stay generic without property/prototype evaluation.
Only INVALID_PROVIDER_RESPONSE can read providerResponseDiagnostic. Its existing private map returns a copy of fixed field/kind only. Public issue/code getters and attributes are ignored.
Fifth actual-adapter failure after four mixed observations emits no usage counts or values; original ACCOUNT_USAGE_INVALID 409 remains.
Lost audit reply, application deactivation after committed audit, lost authentication and replaced pending read marker cannot disclose a misleading trusted diagnostic.
Authorized denials keep original 409/code/reason. Authentication loss preserves the pre-existing 401 and suppresses both usage diagnostics, verified on unchanged RED product.
Diff adds no read/retry. Exact synthetic call sequences enforced; real HTTP-mapped 503 Retry-After retains blocked cooldown and prevents a second invocation from reading.

Responses and audits exclude synthetic raw messages, session/account UID, primary hash, primary account identifiers and partial usage. Cache-Control stays private, no-store. Transport logging remains the existing fixed marker in frozen tests.

Connection rows preserved except existing guard cooldown state where applicable; status remains reauth_required, no successful revalidation receipt, workspace mutation or bank sync. ORGA observation does not repair consent.

Three test files byte-identical RED/product/docs. Reconstruction of base tests permits only three mock exports, one strengthened expected BANK_TIMEOUT field, and 36 added cases; all other original bytes match.
Independent RED repeats exact producer 25 failure names; parsed expected-vs-actual objects differ only by missing providerFailure. Same frozen 37 focus pass after fix; 357 full affected cases pass.
Guarded TypeScript exits 0 from sites after local symlink is replaced by independent physical dependency copy. Initial guard refusal retained unchanged.
